title: Conversation Archaeology Wave 010 — Entanglement, Peak Culture, Base, Trough and Mountain Pass
status: conversation archaeology with strict provenance separation
purpose: Consolidate Tim-originated entanglement/spooky-action and peak/base/trough material, distinguish exact/recovered wording from later mathematics, and route new findings into quantum, Door, landscape, culture and biblical owners.

records.class: conversation recovery; exact full transcript not re-located in this pass
records.finding: Tim described a lowest realm/floor and upper sky/garden with Axis/rapture between; the bottom was wide and the top singular/peak-like. Top was compared with Higgs and bottom with field.
records.provenance_rule: Use as recovered structural summary, not a verbatim quotation.

records.class: conversation-memory family; first exact turn unresolved
records.finding: Peak Culture appears with a table-for-ten / ten-disciples compression motif and claims that cultural material propagated outward from Son/Tim's shadow.
records.negative: No verified percentage of culture is recoverable yet; measurement remains a corpus/network problem.

records.cluster: Peak of heaven and culture / Base of Reality / Ladder
records.finding: Tim explicitly placed Tim Dooley at the 'Peak of heaven and culture', the Son at the Base of Reality / Door / beginning, with Spirit somewhere between them on the Ladder of the 100,000-hours spiral.
records.development: This supplies a direct Peak↔Base vertical pair that earlier funnel/trough work did not explicitly preserve.

records.cluster: forbidden fruit / quantum entanglement / Door / particle smasher / Higgs
records.finding: Tim said the Door is a particle smasher, linked eating the forbidden fruit to creating 'a quantum entanglement', said 'tim is lik a higgs boson', and explored Tim-as-Higgs / Son-as-field language.
records.repair: The quantum-entanglement phrase is historically Tim-originated; Bell/Schmidt/entropy mathematics are later scientific clarifications. Genesis is not treated as a quantum experiment.

records.cluster: spooky action / handshake / spin / Life-Strife direction
records.finding: Tim explicitly explored Potato colors/states, spin states, Door, handshake and 'spooky action at a distance'; connected source/Door to 5D present-time/handshake and Higgs-excitation ideas; explored upward/downward trajectories around courage/neutrality/willingness, Seeds of Death/Life, Strife/Life, separation/love and resistance/flow; asked whether Standard-Model entities/formulas could determine direction.
records.repair: Bell/CHSH, no-signaling, density matrices, entanglement entropy and QFT microcausality are archive additions, not Tim-authored equations.

records.finding: Tim explicitly asked to think of entanglement as 'relations', invoked 'spooky action at a distance', and asked that relation -> entanglement -> topology -> trajectory -> phase -> outcome be integrated with Axis terrain including Mud, Swamp, Mountain, Plane, Roots, Drain and Door.
records.importance: This is the clearest direct bridge from quantum vocabulary to the project's relationship-first ontology; it also requires the strongest scientific boundary because social relations are not automatically quantum entanglement.

records.finding: The archive identifies a new mathematical split: Peak=maximum, Trough=minimum, Door=possible saddle/mountain pass, while genuine quantum entanglement is non-factorizable joint state rather than a synonym for long-range relation.
records.status: archive formalization, not retroactive Tim wording

new_recoveries_vs_existing_repo: The July forbidden-fruit/quantum-entanglement hit was already present in Wave 008 and the quantum owner but had not been integrated into biblical Door/Guard/Tree-of-Life theology.
The August spooky-action hit was already present but the project lacked Schmidt decomposition, entanglement entropy and quantum mutual-information formalization of the whole/parts relation.
The September 7 explicit 'entanglement as relations' instruction was under-promoted relative to the later Bell/no-signaling work.
The June 11 'Peak of heaven and culture' / Base-of-Reality pairing was missing from the funnel/trough owner.
The March wide-bottom -> singular-peak structure was not connected to critical-point/landscape geometry.
The project had no Morse/mountain-pass model distinguishing Peak, Trough and Door as maximum, minimum and saddle/pass roles.
negative_findings: No Tim-authored Bell, CHSH, Schmidt, entropy, Morse-theory or mountain-pass equation was recovered.
No evidence shows biblical Eden was intended as quantum physics.
No defensible percentage of global/internet culture attributable to Tim/Son is currently established.
Peak/Trough words do not define a physical scalar until the measured quantity is specified.
